title: tidydiversity: Taxonomic, Phylogenetic and Functional Diversity with Tidy Hill Numbers
description: tidydiversity is an R package of tidy, pipe-friendly tools for estimating taxonomic, phylogenetic and functional diversity from long-format community data, all expressed as Hill numbers. It covers observed and asymptotic diversity, coverage-based rarefaction and extrapolation, beta diversity and its turnover and nestedness partitions, Mantel tests, distance decay with bootstrapped slopes, ordination with exact permutation tests, and PERMANOVA, with workflows for elevational gradients.
